cohort: Women who gave birth (≥ 22 weeks) in a level III hospital from 2004 through 2013
finding: Immediate postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) and maternal age ≥ 35 years were the only factors associated with severe secondary PPH.
mod_finding: This study notes that cesarean birth was examined as a potential risk factor for secondary postpartum hemorrhage, but it was not associated with a statistically significant increase.
